content.text: Imagine you're a digital creator in Kenya, living in a country where Stripe and PayPal refuse to serve you. One day, you're proud to launch your new ebook: a comprehensive guide to Kenyan folklore, filled with beautiful templates and captivating stories. However, when you try to set up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-step-step-deployment-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] system to sell it, you're met with a brick wall. Stripe and PayPal are unreachable due to local restrictions. Your only option is to give up on your project or take an exorbitant hit on your earnings by using a third-party service that drains your profits. This is not just a headache for you; it's a symptom of a bigger problem: the lack of sovereignty in commerce infrastructure. Your digital assets, your creations, and your brand deserve better. They deserve a payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers|The Real]]-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment|architecture]] that is not beholden to the whims of third-party providers.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-works-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Infrastructure sovereignty refers to the ability of individuals and organizations to control and manage their own digital infrastructure without relying on external services. In the context of commerce, this means creating a payment architecture that is not dependent on Stripe, PayPal, or any other third-party provider. This is crucial for creators like yourself who face restrictions or prohibitions on using these services in your country. By having full control over your payment infrastructure, you can avoid the risks associated with giving your customers' data and payments to a platform you don't own or control. You can also keep your profits intact by minimizing the fees charged by third-party services. This is what COREMERCH offers: a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to deploy a full-fledged payment system without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH's payment architecture is built using a combination of open-source technologies and cloud services. It starts with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your online store, followed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for processing payments. Supabase or Google Sheets are used for storing orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 are used for delivering digital products to your customers. The final piece of the puzzle is NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that allows your customers to pay with over 300 cryptocurrencies. The architecture is designed to be modular, scalable, and highly customizable, giving you full control over the payment experience of your customers. By using this architecture, you can avoid the risks associated with relying on third-party providers and keep your profits intact.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment architecture is built specifically for digital creators like yourself who face restrictions or prohibitions on using Stripe, PayPal, or other third-party payment services. These services often have strict requirements and onboarding processes that can be challenging for creators in developing countries. By providing a sovereign payment infrastructure, COREMERCH aims to democratize access to digital commerce and give creators the freedom to sell their products without restrictions. This is not just about avoiding fees; it's about maintaining control over your brand, your customers' data, and your profits.
With COREMERCH, you have full control over your payment infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of COREMERCH's payment architecture include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for payment processing, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for digital product delivery, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Each component is carefully designed to work together seamlessly, ensuring a smooth payment experience for your customers. By using these components, you can create a payment system that is customizable, scalable, and highly secure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying COREMERCH's payment architecture requires a few simple steps. First, sign up for an account on GitHub or Cloudflare and create a new repository for your online store. Next, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for payment processing and integrate it with Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Finally, configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for digital product delivery and integrate it with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. To get started, you can purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes a comprehensive guide to setting up COREMERCH's payment architecture, along with instant access to all the necessary blueprints and templates.
